items: Weights 40/20/20/10/10, the 90-day / 30-day current stance, the ±20 camp cuts, the 10-year history half-life, the shrinkage formula, the ±25 default for an unquantified move, and interview weights (official 1.0, two-source verbatim 0.25, paraphrase 0.10, unbestätigt 0) are not validated.

The attempted mapping from a speaker's stated path to the market path at the time of the statement does not hold. The public «vs. Markt» column is therefore a direction only (more hawkish than priced, less hawkish than priced, in line with pricing, or n/a). Basis-point figures taken from market pricing, futures or odds, and proxy series names are not in this package.

The main public camp is Variant B: each member's own scored events, 90-day window, 30-day half-life, cuts at ±20. Trend is the current own-score stance minus the structural own-score lean (material at ±15). Members without a scored event in the 90-day window are labelled «nicht eingeordnet»; there is no fallback camp.

The interview layer is included at reduced weight. Reuters, Bloomberg, WSJ, FT, CNBC and similar licensed outlets are linked or given a short paraphrase at most; licensed verbatim is omitted. Unbestätigt interviews are not counted. Daly's 14.10 and 6.11 appearances remain unbestätigt (single source).

Coverage gaps remain. Daly, Powell, Kashkari, Venable and Shukla are «nicht eingeordnet». Kashkari's recent listed appearances have no official transcript. Venable's recent official messages have no current rate path. Provisional labels are kept where the in-window official record is thin.
Barkin 9.11.2026 ('The Rooms Driving the Economy') remains unresolved after two-pass A/B and a third pass (timing-urgency dispute) and is not forced into the average.
Schmid's current own-score stance is +20.2, just above the +20 Hawk cut-off. A small revision to the latest event would change the camp.

Official-transcript quotes may contain '25 basis points' or similar when that is the speaker's own wording. Those phrases are the speaker's words, not figures taken from market pricing, and are not treated as leaks (same rule as in v3.2b).

lean_history is a monthly Variant B current-stance series (90/30) reconstructed from the same scored events. A point is flagged provisional when fewer than four events sit in that 90-day window. It is not a real-time vintage of the published package.
